definitionZh: 弹性成形的 CSS 属性设置了弹性成形因子,该因子指定了弹性容器正自由空间的多少(如果有的话)应该分配给弹性项目的主要大小.
sourceDefinition: The flex-grow CSS property sets the flex grow factor, which specifies how much of the flex container's positive free space, if any, should be assigned to the flex item's main size.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The flex-grow CSS property sets the flex grow factor, which specifies how much of the flex container's positive free space, if any, should be assigned to the flex item's main size.
